description: Add BroadcastMention struct (scope: String, offset: u64, length: u64) and broadcast_mentions: Vec<BroadcastMention> field to Message in jmap-chat-types. Defined in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §4.14 lines 329-351. scope is one of 'everyone', 'here', 'admins'. Follow existing Mention pattern (same serde attrs, #[non_exhaustive], extra field). Add to Message alongside mentions field. Add VALID_BROADCAST_SCOPES constant or similar. This is upstream work in the jmap-chat-types repo, not in kith. kith will continue using the local workaround (BroadcastMention in kith-core, carried in Message.extra) until the next jmap-chat-types release.
title: Add BroadcastMention type and field to jmap-chat-types
